title: Give claim checks a cheap trigger
paras: Clarifications have `looks_like_a_question`; edge cases have the code graph's bug list; a claim check runs only when the analysis names `verify_claim`. An analysis that is busy scoring depth and relevance may not flag a confident wrong complexity.

A small pattern (`O(`, *always*, *guarantees*, *is thread-safe*, *never blocks*) on candidate text would queue the check deterministically. The 0.6 confidence floor and the incorrect/misleading filter already keep false alarms off the panel.
